_comment: Tune thresholds/durations here - no code changes needed. Gifts fall into one of 3 tiers by diamondCount: small (< bigGift.minDiamondValue) shows the small OBS gift card, bigGift (>= its minDiamondValue, < mvp.minDiamondValue) shows the big-gift browser overlay, mvp (>= its minDiamondValue) shows the full-screen luxury MVP overlay.

mvp._comment: The full-screen luxury (private jet / VIP club) celebration for whale gifts.

battleWinner._comment: Full-screen celebration when a Box/Guest Battle winner is announced from the dashboard. The winner is also auto-added to vipList.json.

welcome._comment: The special VIP banner shows for anyone whose username is listed in config/vipList.json.

milestone._comment: Fires once per threshold per stream session (resets when the tiktok-listener process restarts). Edit these numbers to match your channel size.
